capabilities.command: {name:play|pause|stop|seek|launch_scene|launch_clip|stop_track|stop_clips|view|save_project|export_wav|export_stems|export_midi,args?:{beat?,scene? (zero-based),trackId?,view?:session|arrangement,source?:auto|session|arrangement,sampleRate?:44100|48000|88200|96000,bitDepth?:16|24|32 (32=float),normalize?:boolean,dither?:none|triangular (none for float),includeTail?:boolean,range?:{start,length} (zero-based Arrangement beats),channel?:master|track:ID|return:ID (WAV only)}} runtime operation; launch_clip presses a trigger/toggle Session slot; launch_scene and clip stops wait for quantized activation. Gate/repeat clip holds remain manual. Session export snapshots active clips from their beginnings for four bars, excluding Arrangement automation; auto prefers Arrangement. Defaults: 44.1 kHz/24-bit, no normalization/dither, tails included. Range forces Arrangement and cannot combine with Session source. export_stems downloads an aligned ZIP of all tracks and returns before the master bus; each file obeys mute/solo, crossfade and independent normalization/dither. Channel selection is WAV-only. export_midi uses its own args: source clip or arrangement (default arrangement), clipId for a full clip loop, optional owning trackId for clip effects, trackIds for chosen Arrangement tracks, range for Arrangement only, applyEffects boolean (default false). MIDI ignores mixer mute/solo and excludes audio, instruments, audio effects and automation. A processed shared clip requires an explicit owning trackId. Do not pass audio encoding/rate/tail settings to MIDI. Combine up to eight after project edits, or stop/pause before edits
capabilities.region_fades: {ids:[existing Arrangement REGION IDs],fadeIn? (beats),fadeOut? (beats)} set audio/generated-loop region edge fades. Durations are independent, 0..each region length; 0 clears an edge. Linear fades cannot overlap each other or cross source-loop boundaries; values outside those bounds reject atomically. Excludes MIDI. Does not change source clips, source offsets, mixer automation or Session playback; one atomic Undo. Split/time-cropped fades retain original gain segments; setting a duration resets that edge to a full 0-to-1 or 1-to-0 fade
capabilities.add_track: {name,ref? (unique $alias for subsequent actions),preset? (Init|Warm bass|Soft pad|Bright pluck)}
capabilities.device: {trackId,type?,deviceId?,remove?,enabled?,params?} add/update/remove an effect on a track or return
capabilities.instrument: {trackId,preset?,kind?:poly|drums|sampler,sampleClipId?,params?} presets for poly; sampler copies audio from an existing clip
capabilities.add_return: {name,ref?} create a return with wet reverb
capabilities.midi_effects: {trackId,effectsJSON:JSON-encoded array of complete MIDI effect objects from session}
capabilities.midi: {ref?,clipId?,trackId?,scene?,name?,beats,notes:[{pitch,start,duration,velocity}]} replaces notes or creates MIDI clip
capabilities.region_group: {ids:[existing Arrangement region IDs],action:move|duplicate|delete|active|trim,delta? (beats),trackOffset? (move/duplicate only),edge?:start|end (trim only)} trim moves all chosen starts or ends by one shared quarter-beat-snapped delta; positive moves right, negative left. Shorten starts by 1 beat: edge=start,delta=+1. Shorten ends by 1 beat: edge=end,delta=-1. Negative start delta extends earlier; positive end delta extends later. Starts preserve original ends and source timing. Clamp together at timeline/minimum length boundaries, reject overlaps atomically. Does not alter source clips or track automation
capabilities.time: {operation:insert|delete|duplicate,start,length,trackIds?} beats are zero-based; omit trackIds for whole song
